Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring labeling on food from cloned animals.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to food from cloned animals; and adding a newsection to chapter 15.04 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 15.04 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) All food and food products sold in Washington state that arederived from cloned animals shall be labeled indicating that they areor contain products derived from cloned animals. (2) As used in this section, "cloned animal" means an animalproduced by replacing all the genetic material in an egg with a maturecell containing the complete genetic code from the donor.
